saw_lines: Water safety buyers pick for one activity, check how it works before the price, then replace it each season.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer looks for the guarantee and shipping.
Your site offers a 30 day money-back guarantee, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it. Open three new ads with the guarantee in line one and print it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a 30 day money-back guarantee, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so a first buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with the guarantee in line one and print it on the creative.

Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so buyers must guess when the order arrives. Open two ads for new buyers with free shipping over 150€ in line one, then the delivery time.
8 of 30 copy ads open on one line, “Deine Saison ist nicht vorbei,” and the rest each open once. Test two new openers against it, one on your 2688+ five star reviews and one on price, three ads each.
The median ad runs 124 words and the longest hits 178, so the product and any offer sit deep in the copy. Cut each ad to two lines and the guarantee, and lead with the safety set.
